results.name: Hover Dropdown
results.before: Top-left 'Products ▾' button shown in its default/unfocused state on a light background; page body displays the text 'Welcome to the application dashboard.' and no menu is visible.
results.after: The 'Products' button appears visually active (darker background) with the mouse cursor positioned over it, and a bordered dropdown menu has appeared beneath the button listing 'Analytics', 'Integrations', and 'Documentation'.
results.trigger: Mouse cursor hover (mouseover) over the 'Products' button caused the dropdown to appear (a click could also produce this, but the visible cursor over the button suggests hover).

results.name: Tooltip Appearance
results.before: Small light-blue square icon containing a small yellow glyph sits near the top-left of a white canvas with the label 'Documenteditor view' visible beneath it; no mouse pointer or tooltip is present.
results.after: A black triangular mouse cursor is positioned over the icon and a dark rectangular tooltip reading 'Add to favorites' has appeared to the right/below the icon; the previous label is no longer visible in the cropped view.
results.trigger: A mouse hover (cursor moved over the small icon) triggered the tooltip to appear.

results.name: Modal Dialog Open
results.before: Light background (off-white/very light gray) with a blue "New Project" button near the top-left and the text "Project dashboard listing 5 items" below it; no modal or dim overlay present.
results.after: Screen is darkened by a translucent dark-gray backdrop and a centered white modal titled "Create New Project" appears containing a text input placeholder "Project Name..." and a blue "Confirm" button at the lower right of the modal.
results.trigger: User likely clicked the "New Project" button, opening a modal dialog and adding a dark translucent backdrop to dim the rest of the screen.

results.name: Drag and Drop Task
results.before: Two-column task board with headings 'TO DO' (left) and 'IN PROGRESS' (right). A white task card labeled 'Design App Icon' is inside the left 'TO DO' column near the top. The right column contains no cards.
results.after: The same white task card labeled 'Design App Icon' is now inside the right 'IN PROGRESS' column at roughly the same vertical position. A mouse pointer is visible hovering over or just to the right of the moved card.
results.trigger: The item was moved from the left 'TO DO' column to the right 'IN PROGRESS' column, most likely via a drag-and-drop action (mouse pointer visible near the card in frame 2 indicates recent or ongoing pointer interaction).

results.name: Loading Spinner to Content
results.before: Page titled 'Data Feed' with a large blue circular loading spinner centered and the caption 'Loading metrics..' beneath it on an otherwise blank white background.
results.after: The loading spinner is gone; two pale rectangular metric panels appear under the 'Data Feed' title showing 'Active Users: 12,450' in the first panel and 'Uptime: 99.98%' in the second.
results.trigger: The system finished fetching data while the user waited, replacing the loading indicator with populated metric cards (automatic data load completion).

results.name: Tab Switch
results.before: Top tab bar shows 'Overview' as active (blue underline). Main content reads 'Welcome to system overview report' on an otherwise blank page.
results.after: Top tab bar shows 'Settings' as active (blue underline) with a small triangular pointer near the label. Main content reads 'Configure application preferences and notifications.'
results.trigger: User selected the 'Settings' tab (likely clicked the 'Settings' label), causing the active tab and main content to switch.

results.name: Sidebar Expansion
results.before: Left sidebar is collapsed to a narrow dark strip showing three small square icons stacked vertically; main workspace area labeled 'Main workspace content area' occupies the rest of the screen.
results.after: Left sidebar is expanded to a wider dark panel showing the same icons with text labels ('Home', 'Settings') and a white triangular indicator near the top icon; the main workspace area is shifted right.
results.trigger: Most likely the user activated the menu button at the top of the collapsed sidebar (e.g., clicked the top icon/hamburger) which expanded the sidebar to reveal labels.

results.name: Carousel Slide Transition
results.before: Slide displayed on a pale blue rectangular area with centered text 'Slide 1: Summer Sale'. A small square/control icon is visible near the right edge of the slide area.
results.after: Slide content changed to a pale peach rectangular area with centered text 'Slide 2: Autumn Styles'. A black triangular mouse cursor appears near the same right-edge control icon.
results.trigger: The user advanced to the next slide, likely by clicking the right-side next/control button (cursor is visible near that control in the second frame).

results.name: Toast Notification
results.before: A page with a blue 'Save Changes' button near the top-left and grey text 'Profile settings form fields' below; no notification is visible.
results.after: A green notification bar appears at the top-right with white text reading 'Changes saved successfully' (with a small icon), while the blue 'Save Changes' button and grey descriptive text remain.
results.trigger: User clicked the 'Save Changes' button, causing a success notification to appear.

results.name: Async List Update
results.before: Inbox header reads 'Inbox (2 messages)'. Two list items shown: '1. Alex: Review design doc' and '2. Sam: Standup 10am', each in a white rounded rectangle.
results.after: Inbox header reads 'Inbox (3 messages)'. A new top item '1. Taylor: PR ready for review (NEW)' appears above the previous items. The new item is visually highlighted with a light-blue background and blue border, and the existing items are renumbered to 2 and 3 and pushed down.
results.trigger: A new message was added to the inbox and inserted at the top; the new entry is marked '(NEW)' and appears to be automatically focused/selected (highlighted) by the UI rather than just hovered.
